long_biography.plain_text:
Manoukian developed an investment portfolio spanning property, retail, pharmaceuticals and biotechnology. In Pennsylvania, he became Greenwood Racing's primary financial backer and acquired a controlling interest in its gaming business. Greenwood owns the group behind Parx Casino, where his net interest now stands at nearly 89 percent.

His role is principally that of owner and investor. Greenwood has a separate chief executive and operating team, so the company's day-to-day management should not be attributed solely to him. His wider activities have also included entertainment, renewable energy and charitable projects. The ownership structures behind those interests are not sufficiently disclosed to treat every company or family asset as his personal holding.

uncertainties.detail: Current records use Watche Manoukian, Watche A. Manoukian and Watche “Bob” Manoukian. The source record uses Vatche as a transliteration variant. No name-field restructuring is proposed because Bob is the established working name and the source deliberately preserves both forms.

A separate Vatche Manoukian, born in March 1979, is a London-based lawyer and venture investor associated with IMS Digital Ventures. His career, nationality and company appointments were excluded from the target record.
Current Pennsylvania records list Watche A. Manoukian and Yeghiche Watche Manoukian separately. Yeghiche was not treated as the target's fuller legal name.

Two established profiles support Lebanon as birth country, but no reliable public source located in this review established a city. The existing 20 September 1949 date was not independently corroborated and is left unchanged.
Sources describe Manoukian as Armenian and born in Lebanon, but do not clearly distinguish ethnicity from current citizenship. Armenian remains unchanged and no secondary nationality is proposed.

Profiles connect his earlier career with the Brunei royal family and list diverse investments, but do not establish one original wealth-creation sector or the source of his initial capital. Wealth creation industry and wealth origin therefore remain Unknown.

Manoukian is the dominant Greenwood shareholder. Current filings identify separate executives and operating partners, so the biographies classify him as an investor and avoid describing him as the casino's day-to-day operator.
The broad sector list is documented as business involvement, not a complete schedule of personally owned assets. The biographies do not assign every family or company holding to Manoukian personally.

No personal LinkedIn, Instagram or personal website was verified to the required confidence. Company and philanthropic pages were used as research sources rather than proposed personal social profiles.
Private-family details, allegations, controversies, legal disputes and vessel-specific research were excluded. A court opinion was used only for its public corporate-ownership finding.
